item.tib: rdzogs pa chen po zhang zhung snyan rgyud kyis bla ma brgyud pa'i bstod phyag
item.coloph: de ltar zhang zhung me ri'i sngags sems kyi rgyud phyag 'di ni/ yang ston chen po yan chad 'gro mgon klu brag pas mdzad pa yin/ de phyin chad brgyud pa rnams dad mos gus pa chen po'i stobs kyis khyung sgom dpal 'byor lhun grub zhes bya bas sbyar ba'o//
